comment on the issue: When reporters asked about the rising prices, the minister refused to comment on the issue and quickly left.
記者問到物價上漲時，部長拒絕評論議題，隨即匆匆離開。
no comment: When reporters asked about the rumors, the actor's manager simply replied with "no comment" and closed the door.
記者詢問傳聞時，那位演員的經紀人只回了一句「無可奉告」就關上了門。
comment publicly: The company has not yet commented publicly on the accident, but a statement is expected tomorrow morning.
公司尚未公開評論這起意外，但預計明天早上會發表聲明。
commission a report: Worried about the dirty air, the city decided to commission a report from independent scientists on pollution levels.
由於擔心空氣污濁，市政府決定委託獨立科學家製作一份關於污染程度的報告。
commission a painting: To celebrate their fiftieth anniversary, the couple decided to commission a painting of their old farmhouse from a local artist.
為了慶祝結婚五十週年，這對夫婦決定委託一位當地畫家為他們的老農舍作畫。
be commissioned as an officer: After four years of training at the military academy, she will be commissioned as an officer in the navy.
在軍校受訓四年後，她將被任命為海軍軍官。
commit a crime: The police believe the man ran away because he had just used a knife to commit a crime at the store.
警方認為那名男子逃跑是因為他剛在店裡持刀犯罪。
commit suicide: Experts say that anyone who talks about wanting to commit suicide needs support and should be encouraged to seek help.
專家表示，任何談到想要自殺的人都需要支持，並應被鼓勵尋求協助。
commit oneself to: After her brother's car accident, she decided to commit herself to teaching young people about road safety.
在哥哥發生車禍後，她決定承諾投入教導年輕人道路安全的工作。
commit resources: The city has promised to commit resources to cleaning up the river so that families can swim there again.
市政府承諾投入資源清理河川，讓家庭能再次在那裡游泳。
commit to memory: Before opening night, every actor must commit to memory hundreds of lines so they never need to look at the script.
首演之夜前，每位演員都必須記住數百句台詞，這樣就完全不需要看劇本。
be committed to education: Our principal is committed to education for every child and has spent thirty years helping students from poor families.
我們的校長致力於為每個孩子提供教育，三十年來一直在幫助貧困家庭的學生。
communicate one's ideas: In a job interview, you need to communicate your ideas clearly and confidently so the interviewer understands your strengths.
在工作面試中，你需要清楚且自信地傳達想法，讓面試官了解你的優勢。
communicate with gestures: Unable to speak the local language, the tourist had to communicate with gestures, pointing at the map for the driver.
因為不會說當地語言，那名遊客只好用手勢溝通，指著地圖給司機看。
the disease is communicated: Doctors explained how the disease is communicated, warning that it spreads easily from person to person through coughing.
醫生解釋了疾病如何傳播，並警告它很容易透過咳嗽在人與人之間散播。
commute to work: Every day, my father commutes to work by train, and he usually reads the newspaper during the forty-minute ride.
我父親每天搭火車通勤上班，通常會在四十分鐘的車程中看報紙。
commute a sentence: Because the prisoner had truly changed, the president decided to commute a sentence of life in prison to ten years.
因為那名囚犯真心悔改，總統決定減刑，把無期徒刑改為十年。
commute an hour each way: She lives far out in the suburbs and has to commute an hour each way, so she listens to podcasts.
她住在很遠的郊區，單程通勤一小時，所以她會聽播客。
compel obedience: Some strict parents use fear to compel obedience, but children usually learn better through patience and kindness.
有些嚴格的父母用恐懼迫使孩子服從，但孩子通常在耐心和仁慈中學得更好。
be compelled to resign: After the secret recordings were made public, the minister was compelled to resign within a week.
秘密錄音公開後，那位部長在一週內就被迫辭職。
a compelling argument: She made such a compelling argument for longer lunch breaks that the principal agreed to change the school rules.
她提出了一個如此有說服力的論點支持延長午休，讓校長同意修改校規。
compel attention: The bright red poster in the hallway was designed to compel attention from every student who walked past.
走廊上那張鮮紅色的海報是為了引人注目，吸引每位經過的學生。
compensate for the loss: The insurance company paid the family a large sum to compensate for the loss of their house in the fire.
保險公司付給這家人一大筆錢，以彌補他們房子在火災中燒毀的損失。
compensate victims: The factory agreed to compensate victims of the chemical leak by paying all of their medical bills.
工廠同意賠償化學外洩的受害者，支付他們所有的醫療費用。
compensate for a weakness: Short basketball players often learn to compensate for a weakness in height by becoming faster and smarter on the court.
身材矮小的籃球員常學會用在場上變得更快、更聰明來彌補身高上的弱點。
compete for jobs: Every year, thousands of new graduates compete for jobs at top companies, so a strong résumé is very important.
每年都有數千名應屆畢業生競爭頂尖公司的工作，所以一份出色的履歷非常重要。
compete with rivals: To compete with rivals that sell cheaper phones, the company added new features without raising its prices.
為了與販售更便宜手機的對手競爭，這家公司在不漲價的情況下增加了新功能。
compete in the Olympics: She has trained in the pool every morning since she was eight because her dream is to compete in the Olympics.
她從八歲起每天早上都在泳池訓練，因為她的夢想是參加奧運。
